item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-10-03
item.description: Three institutionally dense placements documenting the Chinese-frontier-lab-open-source-surface at three institutional layers this series' prior briefings have not documented at before. (1) The 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit (2026-11-02/05, 27 sub-forums, open-source AI as the summit's headline theme, cyberspace cooperation under the Global Governance Initiative) — the 12th edition as a Chinese-state-diplomatic-magistracy-plus-open-source-AI-diplomatic-platform-plus-community-with-shared-future-in-cyberspace institutional-object layer; first-documented instance in this series of a Chinese-state-organised-diplomatic-magistracy-plus-open-source-AI-diplomatic-platform pairing being operationalized at the summit-preparatory-announcement layer simultaneously with this series' September 18 briefing's BRICS-plus open-source AI zone and this series' September 3 briefing's CNBC-Nvidia-SEC-filing-disclosure layer. (2) Moonshot AI's Hong Kong IPO sovereign-capital-formation — Reuters September 4 confidential filing for ~US$3B at US$50B valuation, Reuters September 10 dual Hong Kong-plus-Shanghai STAR exploration, AlphaSense September 30 IPO preview, Yahoo Finance September 3 "Beijing's Blueprint for Sovereign AI Capital" — with CSRC having declined to grant a VIE exemption (variable-interest-entity unwind required), annual recurring revenue tripling from US$100M (March 2026) to US$300M (June 2026) to US$1B (August 2026) on the back of the July 16 Kimi K3 launch triggering a sixfold daily-sales spike, US$2B annualized revenue target for end-of-year, and the National AI Industry Investment Fund's US$8.8B-in-capital consolidation documented at this series' September 1 briefing — first-documented instance in this series of a Chinese-frontier-lab-capital-formation surface being operationalized at the CSRC-VIE-unwind-plus-dual-listing-plus-sovereign-liquidity-fuel layer simultaneously with the state-directed-capital-plus-frontier-AI-lab-institutional-architecture layer. (3) Jamestown (September 2026) + AEI (October 2, 2026, "The Looming Closure of China's AI Frontier") documenting the Chinese-open-weight-model tiered-governance scholarly layer — Zhang Huibin and Xu Lei's June 2026 "using technology to carry rules" framing, Zhou Hui (Chinese Academy of Social Sciences) as the Model Law on Artificial Intelligence (人工智能示范法) drafting-group lead, Zhang Linghan (China University of Political Science and Law) AI-law-director position, Chen Bing's (Nankai University) three-tier open-source-control proposal (basic filing / strategic export-control-plus-security-assessment / core in-principle-not-open-sourced) — first-documented instance in this series of a Chinese-open-weight-model-tiered-governance-scholarly-framing being operationalized at the international-policy-institute-analysis layer simultaneously with this series' September 19 briefing's SJ/T 12304-2026 LLM open-source grading standard release layer and this series' September 27 briefing's Reuters-mandatory-national-standard-AI-agent-safety-draft layer. One perspective, not a verdict.
